commutative_operad_self_dual.test: Commutative operad Com is self-dual: Com^! ≅ Com
commutative_operad_self_dual.note: Com generated by commutative, associative, unital binary op

bar_cobar_constructions.test: Bar construction B(P) and cobar Ω(P^!) form Koszul duality complex
bar_cobar_constructions.duality: B(P) and Ω(P^!) are adjoint functors

quadratic_koszul_operads.test: Quadratic operads (generated in arity 2 with degree-2 relations) are Koszul

com_self_dual_violation.test: Claiming Com is NOT self-dual → UNSAT

bar_cobar_adjunction_violation.test: Claiming B(P) and Ω(P^!) are NOT adjoint → UNSAT

boundary_lie_com_duality.test: Lie operad Koszul dual: Lie^! ≅ Com
boundary_lie_com_duality.note: Dual of associahedra (E_1) relates Lie and Com

boundary_non_quadratic_operads.test: Non-quadratic operads: some are Koszul (E_∞, Gerstenhaber), some are not
boundary_non_quadratic_operads.note: Koszul property not automatic for non-quadratic operads
